pair.title: Add a Frameo frame
pair.heading: Add your frame
pair.step_one: On the frame, open “Add friend” to display a new friend code.
pair.step_two: Enter that code below and choose the sender name shown on your photos.
pair.no_photo: No photo is sent while connecting.
pair.code_help: Find this code on your frame. It is valid for 12 hours after it is generated.
pair.sender_help: This name accompanies photos sent by Homey.
pair.intro: Connect your Frameo frame to Homey.
pair.frame_hint: A friend code and QR code appear on screen.

repair.title: Reconnect frame
repair.heading: Reconnect your frame
repair.intro: Check the connection or use a new friend code.
repair.same_frame: Use the code from this frame. Your device and Flows are preserved.

device.permission_waiting: Confirm the request on the frame’s screen…
device.preview_permission: Enable the gallery in Homey, then allow this sender to view photos in Settings → My friends on the frame.
device.preview_empty: No visible photos in this frame’s slideshow.
device.preview_failed: The preview could not be loaded. Try again.
device.preview_busy: Another operation is in progress. Try again in a moment.

errors.code_invalid: Enter the full numeric friend code displayed on the frame.
errors.sender_invalid: Choose a sender name between 1 and 80 characters, without line breaks.
errors.pair_failed: The connection could not be confirmed. Check that the frame is online and try a new friend code.
errors.code_expired: This friend code was not accepted. Generate a new code on the frame and try again.
errors.frame_unavailable: The frame could not be reached. Check its power and network connection, then refresh.
errors.not_ready: Frameo is still starting. Please try again in a moment.
errors.timeout: The frame did not respond in time. Please try again.
errors.busy: Another operation is in progress. Please wait for it to finish.
errors.session_closed: The connection window was closed. Start adding the frame again.
errors.already_added: This frame is already in Homey. Use its settings to reconnect it.
errors.wrong_frame: This code belongs to a different frame. Generate a code on the frame you are reconnecting.
errors.refresh_failed: The frame could not be checked. Check its network connection and try again.
errors.send_failed: Receipt of the photo could not be confirmed. Check the frame before sending it again.
errors.url_invalid: Use a valid HTTP or HTTPS address for a photo.
errors.image_too_large: This photo is too large. Choose a smaller image.
errors.image_invalid: This image could not be read. Choose a valid photo.
errors.download_failed: The photo could not be downloaded. Check its address and accessibility.
errors.aborted: The operation was interrupted. You can try again.
errors.permission_denied: The frame did not allow this access request.
errors.permission_timeout: Permission was not confirmed in time. Check the frame before requesting it again.
errors.permission_not_granted: The frame did not confirm the requested permissions.
errors.permission_failed: Photo access could not be requested. Check the frame and try again.
errors.group_invalid: The group name or selected frames are invalid.
errors.group_not_found: This group no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.group_limit: The maximum number of groups has been reached.
errors.group_frame_unknown: A frame in this group is no longer available. Edit the group.
errors.transfer_target_invalid: Choose a valid frame or group.
errors.transfer_source_invalid: Choose one JPEG or PNG photo, or one HTTP or HTTPS link.
errors.transfer_not_found: This send is no longer in the history.
errors.transfer_batch_expired: This sending session has expired. Check Activity before sending again.
errors.transfer_pending: Send __job__ is queued or running. Details in Activity.
errors.transfer_incomplete: Received by __success__ of __total__ frames; __failed__ failed, __uncertain__ need checking. Details in Activity.
errors.transfer_restart_queued: Cancelled before transfer when Homey restarted. Nothing is resent automatically.
errors.transfer_restart_running: Interrupted when Homey restarted. The frame may have received the photo; check before resending.
errors.send_uncertain: The frame did not confirm receipt. The photo may have arrived; check before resending. Nothing is resent automatically.
errors.transfer_journal_failed: Tracking could not be saved. Check the result before sending again.
errors.upload_invalid: Photo preparation is invalid. Prepare the photo again.
errors.upload_not_found: This preparation has expired or no longer exists. Prepare the photo again.
errors.upload_offset_invalid: A photo chunk was not acknowledged correctly. The photo has not been submitted to the frame.
errors.upload_incomplete: Photo preparation is incomplete. The photo has not been submitted to the frame.
errors.upload_limit: Too many photos are being prepared on Homey. Try again in a moment.
errors.upload_failed: Homey could not prepare this photo. The photo has not been submitted to the frame.
errors.auto_refresh_invalid: Choose whether automatic refresh is enabled and a whole-number interval from 1 to 1,440 minutes.
errors.media_monitor_store_failed: The reference media list could not be saved. No new-media detection was confirmed.

qr.title: Scan the QR code
qr.scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code beside the friend code.
qr.take_photo: Take a photo of the QR code
qr.camera_unavailable: The live camera is unavailable here. Use a photo of the QR code or enter the code manually.
qr.camera_denied: Camera access was not allowed. Use a photo of the QR code or enter the code manually.
qr.camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Use a photo of the QR code or enter the code manually.
qr.scanned: Code found. Check it and confirm the connection.
qr.no_code: No QR code found. Move closer to the QR code and take another photo.
qr.wrong_code: Use the QR code shown by “Add friend” on your frame.
qr.invalid_photo: Choose a photo of the QR code.
qr.photo_too_large: This photo is too large. Choose another photo or enter the code manually.
qr.photo_error: This photo could not be read. Try again or enter the code manually.

access.mode_title: How will you use this frame?
access.send_description: Send photos manually or from your Flows.
access.manage_description: Browse and manage photos on the frame.
access.guide_enable: Enable photo viewing and photo management for this friend.
access.guide_notice: No prompt opens automatically. Change these settings on the frame.
access.pending: Viewing and management have not both been confirmed. Check the frame settings, then try again.
access.view_description: Gallery and widgets, without permission to delete photos.
access.guide_enable_view: Enable photo viewing for this friend. Management is not needed for the gallery or widgets.
access.verified_view: Viewing confirmed. The gallery and widgets are available.
access.pending_view: Viewing has not been confirmed. Check the frame settings, then try again.

gallery.title: Your frame, a little closer
gallery.intro: Browse the photos on your frame, right here in Homey.
gallery.privacy: Only the previews shown are loaded. They are kept temporarily for display.
gallery.no_frames: Add a Frameo photo frame in Homey to open its gallery.
gallery.friend_name: Homey appears as “__name__” on this frame.
gallery.disabled_title: Choose how Homey uses this frame
gallery.disabled_intro: Sending only is enabled. Open the gallery to view photos, if this Homey connection has permission.
gallery.permission_intro: Homey needs permission to view photos before it can open this gallery.
gallery.permission_step_frame: On the frame, open Settings → My friends.
gallery.permission_step_friend: Find “__name__”, the name used by this Homey connection.
gallery.permission_step_access: Check permission to view photos. Managing photos also allows deletion.
gallery.permission_step_check: Then return here to check access.
gallery.permission_no_popup: Permissions belong to this Homey connection. Nothing is requested automatically on the frame.
gallery.read_only: You can view these photos. Deleting them also requires permission to manage photos.
gallery.empty_title: A little space for new memories
gallery.empty: There are no photos to display on this frame.
gallery.delete_warning: This permanently deletes this photo from the selected frame. It cannot be undone.
gallery.delete_uncertain: Deletion was not confirmed. Close this preview and refresh the gallery to check before trying any other deletion.
gallery.refresh_required: Refresh the gallery before deleting another photo.
gallery.stale: This gallery may have changed. Refresh to see the latest photos.
gallery.error: The gallery could not be loaded. Please try Refresh.
gallery.preview_error: This preview could not be loaded. Refresh the gallery to try again.
gallery.busy: Another operation is in progress. Try again in a moment.
gallery.denied: Access was not granted. Check this Homey connection’s permissions on the frame.
gallery.unavailable: The frame is unavailable. Check its connection, then refresh.
gallery.invalid: The frame returned an unexpected response. Please refresh.

errors.send_only: This frame is configured for sending only. Enable its gallery to view photos.
errors.permission: Allow this sender to view photos in Settings → My friends on the frame. To delete photos, also allow photo management.
errors.stale: The list expired or changed. Refresh the gallery.
errors.invalid: This request could not be processed. Refresh the gallery.
errors.not_found: This photo is no longer on the frame. Refresh the gallery.
errors.unsupported: This preview is not available in a supported format.
errors.preview_required: Open the photo preview before confirming deletion.
errors.delete_uncertain: Deletion could not be confirmed. Refresh the gallery before any further deletion.
errors.too_large: This preview is too large to display.
errors.too_many: This frame contains more photos than this version can display.
errors.failed: The gallery could not respond. Refresh and try again.
errors.visibility_uncertain: The change was not confirmed. Refresh the gallery before making another change.

gallery.visibility_uncertain: The change was not confirmed. Refresh the gallery before making another change.
gallery.preview_budget: This preview cannot fit in the available memory. Close a preview or refresh.

frameo.no_frame_hint: Select a photo frame in the widget settings.
frameo.send_hint: In the frame’s settings in Homey, choose “Send and manage photos”.
frameo.permission_hint: On the frame: Settings → My friends, choose the sender name configured for Homey and allow viewing photos.
frameo.empty_hint: Add a photo or make one visible in the frame’s slideshow, then try again.
frameo.offline_hint: Check its connection, then try again.
frameo.busy_hint: An operation is in progress. Try again in a moment.
frameo.error_hint: The photo could not be displayed. Please try again.
frameo.timeout_hint: The frame did not respond in time. You can try again.

settings_ui.title: Your frame, your way
settings_ui.intro: Send your photos, revisit your memories and choose where to share them.
settings_ui.send_intro: Choose a frame or group, then the photos to send.
settings_ui.target_empty: This group is empty. Add a frame in Groups.
settings_ui.file_hint: JPEG or PNG only. HEIC photos are not supported. Up to 24 photos, prepared one at a time.
settings_ui.heic: HEIC photos are not supported. Export this photo as JPEG or PNG.
settings_ui.too_large: This photo exceeds the 8 MiB preparation limit. Reduce its size.
settings_ui.invalid_file: This file is not a valid JPEG or PNG photo.
settings_ui.max_items: The selection is limited to 24 items.
settings_ui.url_label: Or add a photo from a link
settings_ui.url_hint: One HTTP or HTTPS link per selection. It must point to a JPEG or PNG image.
settings_ui.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS link without a username or password.
settings_ui.url_one: A link is already in the selection.
settings_ui.caption: Shared caption (optional)
settings_ui.fit_hint: Otherwise, Frameo adjusts the crop to the frame’s screen.
settings_ui.send_stopping: Sending will stop after the current photo.
settings_ui.send_uncertain: A result still needs checking. Nothing is resent automatically; check Activity before trying again.
settings_ui.send_failed: Sending could not be started. Unsubmitted photos remain selected.
settings_ui.send_none: Choose a recipient and at least one photo.
settings_ui.upload_cancelled: Preparation cancelled. The photo has not been sent.
settings_ui.keep_open: Keep this page open until sending has finished.
settings_ui.empty_queue: Your selection will appear here. You can change its order before sending.
settings_ui.group_intro: A frame can belong to several groups. Editing a group does not change photos on the frames.
settings_ui.group_remove_hint: Only the group will be deleted. Frames and their photos are kept. Flows using this group will need updating.
settings_ui.group_no_frames: First add a frame in Homey.
settings_ui.activity_intro: Manual sends and Flows: a result for each frame. “Received” does not mean immediately displayed on screen.
settings_ui.activity_clear_hint: Active sends are kept. No photos are deleted from frames.
settings_ui.metadata_error: This information could not be loaded. Please try again.
settings_ui.close_warning: Sending is in progress. Keep this page open until it finishes.
settings_ui.widget_hint: Widgets: add “Frameo photo” from your dashboard’s catalogue. Compact, Square and Large portrait are separate entries. The button changes the widget preview, not the photo displayed on the frame.
settings_ui.flows_hint: Automations: in a Flow, add a Frameo action to send an image or link to a frame or group.
settings_ui.reason_offline: The frame or connection is unavailable.
settings_ui.reason_permission: The required permission has not been granted on the frame.
settings_ui.reason_format: The image format is not supported.
settings_ui.reason_unverified: The frame did not confirm the result. The photo may have arrived; check before resending.
settings_ui.diagnostic_title: A diagnostic report to share if needed
settings_ui.diagnostic_intro: Create a technical snapshot from information already in memory, without contacting the frames.
settings_ui.diagnostic_privacy: Only versions, counters, permissions and error codes. No photos, keys, names, captions, pairing codes, addresses, URLs or frame or transfer identifiers. The report is created at your request and is not sent to anyone.
settings_ui.diagnostic_ready: The report is ready. Review its contents before choosing to share it.
settings_ui.diagnostic_copy_hint: If downloading is unavailable in the Homey app, copy the report text instead.
settings_ui.diagnostic_download_requested: Download requested. If it does not start in the Homey app, use Copy report.
settings_ui.diagnostic_manual_copy: The text is selected. Touch and hold it, then choose Copy from your phone’s menu.
settings_ui.diagnostic_failed: The diagnostic report could not be prepared safely. Try again.
